A fifteen-part research series examining how agentic artificial intelligence
is reorganising the software, consumer, and hardware-infrastructure layers of
the economy. Each report states its claims in falsifiable form, separates
measured figures from estimated ones, and cites primary sources only.

Every report is available as a web page and as a PDF.
